1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2.strategy: Completes the fianchetto: the bishop looks down the long diagonal at d5 and b7 and will shelter the castled king. The set-up is solid and flexible, and White fights for the centre with pieces first instead of occupying it at once.

1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 O-O.strategy: Brings the king to safety behind the bishop on g7 and the pawns on f7, g6 and h7 before the centre is decided. Black lets White commit first and keeps every plan in the centre available.
